from scope import Counter, add, tally, widest


def test_add_sums():
    assert add(2, 3) == 5


def test_tally_doubles():
    assert tally([1, 2]) == [2, 4]


def test_widest_over_two_signs():
    assert widest([-7, 3]) == -7


def test_bump_increments():
    counter = Counter()
    assert counter.bump() == 1
